question.instructions: Classify this online banking customer message into exactly one of the listed intents. Choose the single intent that best matches what the customer is asking about or reporting.

options.description: A refund the customer expects has not appeared in their account.
options.label: Refund_not_showing_up

options.description: The customer wants to activate a new card.
options.label: activate_my_card

options.description: Minimum or maximum age to open or use an account.
options.label: age_limit

options.description: Using or adding the card with Apple Pay or Google Pay.
options.label: apple_pay_or_google_pay

options.description: Which ATMs can be used, or how to use the card at an ATM.
options.label: atm_support

options.description: Setting up, changing or understanding automatic top-ups.
options.label: automatic_top_up

options.description: A bank transfer into the account has not updated the balance.
options.label: balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer

options.description: A cheque or cash deposit has not updated the balance.
options.label: balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit

options.description: A transfer was refused because the beneficiary is not allowed.
options.label: beneficiary_not_allowed

options.description: The customer wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made.
options.label: cancel_transfer

options.description: The card is expiring soon and the customer asks about a replacement.
options.label: card_about_to_expire

options.description: Where or whether the card is accepted.
options.label: card_acceptance

options.description: When an ordered card will arrive, or that it has not arrived.
options.label: card_arrival

options.description: How long card delivery takes or the estimated delivery time.
options.label: card_delivery_estimate

options.description: Linking a card to the account or the app.
options.label: card_linking

options.description: The card does not work when the customer tries to use it.
options.label: card_not_working
